The '''S-5 "Flashfury"''' was one of the fastest and dangerous [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. It was produced by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
